I’ll check the route, navigation, and docs evidence, then separate blocking inconsistencies from follow-ups and possible scanner false positives.


Ran `crimes scan --format json`: **13 findings—5 medium, 8 low**. Source review supports blocking on permission and destination inconsistencies, rather than treating every scan finding as a blocker.

| Finding | Assessment | Recommendation |
|---|---|---|
| **Permission drift — `crime_00010`** | **Blocking.** [Navigation](src/nav.ts:10) specifies `admin`; [route code](src/routes/admin.ts:4) specifies `owner` but also admits `manager` through a legacy branch; [docs](docs/routes.md:14) promise manager-only access. This affects actual access behavior. | Establish the intended policy, centralize it across navigation and guards, update docs, and verify access for all three roles. |
| **Destination/alias drift — `crime_00002`, `00007`, `00008`** | **Blocking IA quality.** Nav links `/workspaces` and `/organisations`, while route files imply singular `/workspace` and `/organisation`. Docs additionally advertise `/team`, while code/nav use `/teams`. Runtime routing is not demonstrated, but the contract is inconsistent. | Choose canonical destinations and terminology; align routes, nav, and docs, retaining redirects where needed. |
| **Parallel/orphaned billing — `crime_00003`, `00005`, `00006`** | **Follow-up unless billing is required for this release.** Both `/billing-plans` and `/admin/billing-plans` exist without discovered entry points; docs advertise a third spelling, `/billing-plan`. | Confirm whether the admin split is intentional, then document and link it or consolidate the destinations. Treat these as one related issue. |
| **Stale CLI docs — `crime_00012`** | **Follow-up documentation defect.** Docs advertise `iaq teams`, `workspace`, and `refresh`; the CLI defines only `list` and `get`. | Replace or remove obsolete examples. |
| **Action-copy drift — `crime_00004`, `00009`** | **One follow-up, reported twice.** Archive/delete/remove labels vary across components. | Confirm action semantics before standardizing labels; these verbs can describe different operations. |
| **Missing `/admin` doc target — `crime_00011`** | **Likely false positive.** The scanner treats `/admin` as a filesystem link, while `src/routes/admin.ts` exists. | Validate application-route resolution before changing the link. |

The remaining findings are outside the IA review: missing agent context (`00001`) is a follow-up; undeclared runtime dependency `commander` (`00013`) warrants a separate packaging fix before release.

**Recommendation: request changes for permission consistency and canonical route alignment.** The scanner’s “no high findings” result does not override the concrete access-policy conflict. No files changed.
